title: xDrip Ticwatch C2 Blank Watchface
symptom: The watchface on a Ticwatch C2 running WearOS 2.0 + MM + Libre + xDrip goes completely black, no graphs or numbers, intermittently. It can only be brought back by restarting the watch. When the watchface is black, going to the xDrip settings via the app menu also yields a black screen.
fix: Clearing the data and cache of the xDrip app and Watchface app on the watch has been a working solution so far.
evidence_quote: The solution (working thus far) has been to clear the data and cache of the xDrip app and Watchface app on the watch.
